verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can discuss or dismiss a finding, or have Qodo apply the fix directly. A 'Fix with Chat Agent' option fixes findings from within the in-PR chat. The Agentic Toolbox (MCP, Claude Code, Codex and Kiro plugins) also retrieves and resolves review findings through coding agents. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the applied fix lands as a commit or patch on the PR branch, detail on how the in-PR fix flow works, independent or hands-on corroboration of the apply-fix feature.
